name: Garlicky Chicken, Tomato & Asparagus Skillet with Rice-Pasta Pilaf

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 leeks
1 small pkg fresh thyme
2 pints grape tomatoes
2 small bunches asparagus

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water. Set aside to drain.

Trim off the root ends and the dark green tops of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces and place in a medium bowl.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Add leaves to the bowl with the leek.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, use your hands to break the pasta into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the leek and thyme.

Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom; add leek, thyme, and pasta. Cook, stirring constantly, until the pasta turns golden, 1-2 minutes. Stir in the rice, broth, and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp butter, unsalted
32 fl oz (4 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid in the pot comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the pot, and reduce heat to low. Cook until rice and pasta are tender and the liquid is mostly absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry, without turning, until golden underneath, 5-6 minutes (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
While the chicken is cooking, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic; halve tomatoes. Place both in the reserved bowl.

Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus; cut into 1-inch pieces. Once the chicken is done, add asparagus, garlic, and tomatoes to the reserved skillet; stir to combine, then nestle chicken, cooked-side up, into the veggies.
Place skillet in the oven and bake until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, 10-12 minutes.
To serve, divide chicken, veggies, and rice-pasta pilaf between plates. Drizzle skillet sauce over the chicken and enjoy!
